name: Golden Eyes
title: Golden Eyes
description: The golden, beast-like eyes of the Kaelensia reduce the effectiveness of Blindness by SAN*2 (at 25 SAN, this means no Hit penalty is applied, even if you have the status).

name: Flight
title: Flight
description: This unit, having wings, is capable of flight. While Airborne, this unit will hover when using Movement, allowing them to avoid field hazards and traps on the ground.

name: Gain Air
title: Gain Air
description: Leap into the air and hover briefly with your wings, giving you Airborne status. (Airborne status interacts with certain specific skills and has no effect on its own.)

name: Aerial Attacker
title: Aerial Attacker
description: Best suited to attacking from the air. In battle, while you are Airborne, you gain +10 Hit, and a bonus to Power equal to 1 + 30% of your Scaled SAN.

name: Flaming Feathers
title: Flaming Feathers
description: The wings of the Phenex protect from certain elements, namely Fire and Light, granting a 15% Elemental Resistance to those elements. However, the same can not be said of Ice and Darkness damage, and the Phenex takes 15% increased damage from those elements. Furthermore, a limited ability to hover lets them use Movement while Airborne.

name: From the Ashes
title: From The Ashes
description: The power of the Phenex clan was shown once by Heldonis, and his people are not much different. When the Phenex is reduced to 0 HP, if they have at least 1 FP, half of that FP is consumed and the Phenex restores that much HP immediately (min. 1 HP; the FP consumption is reduced by your Scaled SAN%, but the HP restored is not). This effect can only trigger once per 10 Rounds, reduced by 10% of your Scaled SAN.

name: Heavenly Voice
title: Heavenly Voice
description: The Heron's voice is truly magnificient - in the skies and high mountains where they live, those who hear their divine choir may consider themselves truly blessed; provided the same powerful voices don't cause an avalanche. Indeed, so powerful is their blessing, that it grants them the ability to cast spells even while under the effect of the Silence status. However, while Silenced, their spells suffer the following penalties:

name: Heron Physique
title: Heron Physique
description: Herons are greatly in-tune with aural forces, and are more than resilient to them, granting +15% Sound Resistance. Their wings are unused to harsh gales, however, giving them a 15% Wind Weakness.

name: Ancient Song
title: Ancient Song
description: A song of old times in the Heronic language, carrying with it particularly strong galdric magic with it. When used, consumes all of your Momentum and gain Ancient Song LV X (X = Momentum used). At the start of the next round, you finish singing, restoring the HP of all allies excluding yourself by Y (Y = 10 * Ancient Song LV, min. of 10, max. of 15 or character level, whichever is higher).

name: Fleetfoot
title: Fleetfoot
description: Being the fast creatures that they are, this unit gains +1 Move.

name: Fade Out
title: Fade Out
description: Allow yourself to be covered in the shade of night, granting +15 Evade for 3 attacks, 5 rounds. (Expires after being attacked 3 times or when the duration ends.) During night hours, this skill does not cost any FP to use.

name: Black Rend
title: Black Rend
description: Smash your claw into an enemy within 1 range. Deals Slash damage that ignores protection to the target equal to your character level + 50% of Scaled STR, minus your Scaled SAN.

name: Dark Claws
title: Dark Claws
description: Powerful black carapace protects and increases the force of the Shaitan's attacks. They gain +6 (-1 per 10 Scaled SAN) damage to all attacks made with non-ranged weaponry.

name: Future Vision
title: Future Vision
description: An Oracle's vision of far-off places is always clouded with visions of the future, decreasing their Hit and Evade by 10% against any enemy beyond 1 Range. However, the Oracle also sees the future movements of enemies within 1 Range, increasing their Hit and Evade versus them by 10%. All bonuses and penalties are reduced by 1 per 10 Scaled SAN.

name: Aposemagika
title: Aposemagika
description: Passive: Upon using Invite Insanity the first time, deploy a permanent Aposemagika LV0 field effect, which increases the Status Infliction of Aposemagika users by LV%. (+2 LV if butterflies are destroyed next to an enemy, +1 LV if you succeed with a luck-based status infliction, max LV20).

name: Banquet
title: Banquet
description: Vampires feed by biting their target and draining their life essence for themself. Performs a basic attack with a special Vampire Bite weapon (80% STR, 40% SKI damage scaling) on a target within 1 Range. If the attack hits, the Vampire gains Essence equal to the lower of the target's VIT or the Vampire's VIT (min. 10). Additionally, if the attack hits, Sanguine Crest activates, or if it is already active, you recover HP equal to half of your character level (excluding if the attack target had Golden Blood).

name: Healer's Legacy
title: Healer's Legacy
description: When healing an ally or themself with a healing spell or staff battle item, the base Power of that spell is increased by your Scaled SAN. Additionally, when crafting items using the Alchemy skill, they gain +1 bonus Crafting EXP.

name: Hunter's Elegance
title: Hunter's Elegance
description: Being skilled hunters looking for prey in deep jungles, the Wild Elf is less likely to fall victim to its rough edges. X% chance to automatically disarm Pitfall field objects they move over, and reduces the Evade penalty of Thick Vines by X%. (X = Scaled SAN * 2).

name: Crown of Heaven
title: Crown of Heaven
description: The horns that protrude from all Zerans. It is a physical similarity to Zera, as well as being seen as the trophy for the victory of Heaven's Contention. They are extremely hard, and are sensitive to the flow of nearby magic, detecting it in a sense.

name: Apertaurus' Affinity
title: Apertaurus' Affinity
description: Apertaurus are naturally adept at using axes. Some theorize this is due to another labyrinth wandering entity, the minotaur, and their tendency to use them.

name: Arcane Order
title: Arcane Order
description: The stability that defines the ritual that creates a Lich. At high amounts of Focus, this pact is at its strongest, nullifying the chance of divine intervention. When at 60% (-1% per 1 Scaled SAN) FP or higher, the Lich cannot critically, nor can they be critically hit.

name: Dissipate
title: Dissipate
description: Upon destruction of the physical body of the Lich, the arcane energy that actually comprises the Lich returns to the phylactery. Liches will often enchant their belongings to return along with it, greatly reducing the chance that items will be dropped upon defeat in battle.

name: Golden Blood
title: Golden Blood
description: A divine blood that fills the Glykin. They gain immunity to Poison and regenerate 1 (+1 per 2 Scaled SAN) HP every round in combat (max: 10). Any Vampire that tries to Feed on the Glykin will take Light damage. There is also a Faith% chance that any negative status applied to them that lasts 3 rounds or more will be reduced by 1 round.

name: Absorb Poison
title: Absorb Poison
description: One of the reasons why Wyverns and Wyverntouched are considered good omens is that they possess the unique ability to absorb poison through touch. The Wyverntouched can target anyone in melee range who is poisoned and transfer that status to themself.

name: Fire Wing
title: Fire Wing
description: The scaled dragon wings of the Hyattr protect them from Fire, which is their signature element anyway, increasing their Fire Resistance by 15%. However, those same wings are vulnerable to the winds they fly on, increasing their Wind weakness by 15%.

name: Dragon Hover
title: Dragon Hover
description: Leap into the air and hover briefly with your wings, giving you Airborne status. (Airborne status interacts with certain specific skills and has no effect on its own.)

name: Channel Magic
title: Channel Magic
description: Inhale deeply, channeling your focus into a potent magical energy, as well as drawing it in from the air. You recover FP equal to 5 + half of your Scaled SAN, as well as a 'Magic Energy (Dragon)' status until your next turn. If you use Flame Breath while you have that status, you can resize the length of the line, up to double its original size.

name: Channel Destruction
title: Channel Destruction
description: Inhale deeply, drawing up a force of destruction from inside of you and the air you breathe in. You gain a 'Destruction Energy (Dragon)' status until your next turn, which increases your STR and WIL by 2 + 1 per 10 Scaled SAN. If you use Flame Breath while you have this status, the width of the line is increased significantly, and will leave behind Cinders for 2 rounds that deal damage equal to 5 + half of your Scaled SAN. It will also increase the damage of the skill by 100% of your Fire ATK.

name: Fire Breath
title: Fire Breath
description: By utilizing massive amounts of focus, the Hyattr race is capable of launching a line of fire as if they were exhaling. Deals Fire magic damage to all enemies in a line equal to half your Character Level + Scaled SAN. Its effects can change if you have Magic Energy or Destruction Energy stored. If you have Airborne status, you will also move the length of the line, but this requires the last square in the line to be unoccupied.

name: Coil
title: Coil
description: The user coils their body in a defensive position, gaining Guard status LV X (X = Scaled SAN, max LV 60) and restoring 10 HP and FP, plus 1 per 5 Scaled SAN.

name: Artifical Body
title: Artifical Body
description: As a Mechanation's form is very different from a natural creature's, they are less vulnerable to Fire and Ice damage, reducing each by 15%. However, they also suffer a 25% weakness to Electricity as a result.

name: Fox God's Blessing
title: Fox God's Blessing
description: The power of the Great Fox Spirit's blessing, and a magical quality of the Redtail race, letting their luck become augmented in times of great peril.

name: Green Dice
title: Green Dice
description: Changes the magical energies surrounding the Redtail into a green color. While green, your chance to apply and avoid luck-based status effects is improved by 1x (+1x 10 Scaled SAN, max. 5x) your Fortune Level%. However, if your Fortune Level is one, you instead suffer -5% (plus -5 per 10 Scaled SAN) to each.

name: Fox God's Fortune Cookie
title: Fox God's Fortune Cookie
description: Redtails often carry around baskets of home-made fortune cookies in an effort to test out and train their luck. On use, the Redtail pulls out a fortune cookie and eats it, and reads the fortune. Depending on the fortune, the effect changes, which can be (really) bad or (really) good. After you eat a cookie, you can't eat another one for 3 rounds. Otherwise, you'd go through the day's basket in no time.

name: Forest Family
title: Forest Family
description: As beings born from plants, the Doriad doesn't particular mind things like Water and Earth damage, reducing it by 15%. The same cannot be said for Fire and Darkness, which they take 15% more damage from.

name: Omina
title: Fortune Vacuum
description: Omina drain luck from those around them. At the start of every round, all enemies apply or power up Luck Drain LV 1, 2 rounds, and you gain 1 Unluck for each. Enemies who are boss monsters, or are sneaking, or already have Luck Drain LV X (X = 15% of Scaled SAN, min. 3) are immune. If you are suffering from Interference, you do not gain Unluck, and if you are Confused, this skill will not activate at all.

name: Green Misfortune
title: Green Misfortune
description: Consumes 10 Unluck. Targets 1 enemy within 4 Range. That enemy will step on something slippery, knocking them down.

name: Burden Soul
title: Burden Soul
description: The strength of the Dullahan is spiritual in nature, resulting in a body that is less affected by the weight of its collective. Increases your Battle Weight limit by 100, and your maximum carrying capacity by 30. Furthermore, the Interference status, which normally prevents HP and FP recovery, is only half as effective on Dullahans, meaning they still recover 50% of the original total. This resistance is increased by your Scaled SAN.

name: Homunculi Physique
title: Homunculi Physique
description: An artificially created lifeform. Received healing reduced by 15%. HP per point of VIT reduced by 0.5. FP per point of WIL increased by 1.

name: Drop of Nairyf
title: Drop of Nairyf
description: Created from the divine energy of the dead elemental Nairyf. +15% Fire Resistance, -15% Cold Resistance. Immunity to Burn status.

name: Amalgama Mutation
title: Amalgama Mutation
description: The unique nature of the Amalgama will gradually cause their body to 'mutate', giving them new abilities and weaknesses. While the body may not be visibly changed, the Amalgama will know the difference. Grants up to 11 random Amalgama skills, one every 5 character levels. (While the skills you gain are random, you will always gain a certain amount of a specific category, IE Attack, etc.)

name: Chimera Evolution
title: Chimera Evolution
description: Chimeras are magical 'beasts' which can evolve themselves by eating compatible monsters. When interacting with a corpse left behind by an enemy, you will have the option to eat it; doing so requires some physical stamina, but restores some HP and FP. If the remains belong to a race you have not consumed before, you also gain a new permanent racial skill(s) based on the race.

name: Artificial Body
title: Artificial Body
description: As a Mechanation's form is very different from a natural creature's, they are less vulnerable to Fire and Ice damage, reducing each by 15%. However, they also suffer a 25% weakness to Electricity as a result.

name: Banquet (Oni)
title: Banquet (Oni)
description: Oni are known to enjoy drinking blood, even (or especially) during battle. The Oni performs a basic attack with a special Oni Bite weapon (90% STR) on a target within 1 Range. If the attack hits, the Oni gains Sanguine Crest LV 2 (5 rounds). If the Oni already had Sanguine Crest, they refresh its duration and power it up to LV 4, but also become Clumsy for 2 rounds.

name: Hazing Blood
title: Hazing Blood
description: Oni are said to be a hotblooded race, but the truth goes beyond metaphor. While Sanguine Crest is active, at the start of a new round, enemies within 1 Range take magic bonus damage equal to 5 + Sanguine Crest LV + half of the Oni's Scaled SAN. (Excluding enemies who absorb, reflect, or are immune to the damage type, Fire by default. Enemies cannot be defeated by this damage.)

name: Graceless Destruction
title: Graceless Destruction
description: The only thing scarier than an Oni is a drunk Oni. While they are Clumsy, the Oni gains +5% Phys and Mag Defense, and deal +10% Critical Damage with melee weapons.

name: Blood Binding
title: Blood Binding
description: Karakuri are created through blood ritual, one step of which involves binding a Youkai to its artificial body, creating a state similar to a permanent Install. As a result, Karakuri are always treated as youkai for effects that care about such a designation.

name: Profession
title: Profession
description: Humans commonly spend long times studying and preparing for a specific type of job. Thus, when buying a 'History' trait, it does not cost a Trait Point.

name: Quick to Master
title: Quick to Master
description: Humans live in a world where they must constantly adapt to situations and circumstances they find themselves in, which makes them more versatile than other races. They gain +2 class skill points for every class. Additionally, their skill pool size is increased by 2, letting them equip more skills at once.

name: Instinct (Lupine)
title: Instinct (Lupine)
description: Lupines do not go down without a fight. In battle, while at 50% HP or less, they gain a bonus to STR, WIL, DEF, and RES equal to 1 + 10% of your Scaled SAN. At 25% HP or less, the bonus is doubled.

name: War Cry
title: War Cry
description: The Lupine roars, affecting all enemies within a 2 Range circle. Affected enemies suffer Sound magic damage equal to 25 + your Sound ATK, and have a chance to be inflicted with Hunted (LV: 10 + 10% of Scaled SAN), as well as Fear (3 rounds for both).

name: Stay Afloat
title: Stay Afloat
description: Toggle skill. While toggled on, all skills you use will be treated as if they were Airborne Compatible, meaning they won't end your Airborne status.

name: Revive
title: Revive
description: The ressurection power of the Phenex clan is not limited to themselves. While not nearly as powerful, they can utilize the effect on others who are in a bad way. Using this skill also costs 10% of the Phenex's maximum HP. A target ally within 1 Range who is at 0 HP is revived with HP equal to your Scaled SAN*2. The target will not suffer any negative effects of being revived, such as Momentum loss or receiving the Badly Beaten effect.

name: Instinct (Felidae)
title: Instinct (Felidae)
description: The Felidae are fast and when they feel like they're in danger, they get faster. In battle, while at 50% HP or less, they gain a bonus to SKI, CEL, LUC, and GUI equal to 1 + 10% of your Scaled SAN. At 25% HP or less, the bonus is doubled.

name: Leporidae Physique
title: Leporidae Physique
description: More adept at using the ground to their advantage, or simply more capable of avoiding its dangers, the Leporidae is harder to hurt with Earth damage, giving them a 15% resistance to it. Their ears are incredibly powerful, but also somewhat sensitive, and so they take Sound damage harder than others, giving them a 15% weakness to it. Mumbling is also less effective against them.

name: Instinct (Leporidae)
title: Instinct (Leporidae)
description: Leporidae do not like being put into a corner, and when pushed, their keen senses come out in full force. When at 50% HP or less, the effect of Rabbit Foot increases by 50%. At 25% HP or less, when the Leporidae is targeted by a basic attack (or skill that uses a basic attack), before the attack happens, they turn to face the attacker.

name: Rabbit Foot
title: Rabbit Foot
description: Known for their strong legs, the Leporidae are certainly capable of delivering a painful kick. Lesser known is their natural affinity with weather magic, such as lightning, which is displayed better by wild monster hares. After using Rabbit Leap, the first Kick skill or Nature domain spell used this round gains bonus damage equal to (distance moved) + 50% of your Scaled SAN.

name: Rabbit Leap
title: Rabbit Leap
description: Uses the strong legs of the Leporidae to leap to a nearby location.

name: Muridae Instinct
title: Muridae Instinct
description: Muridae are predisposed to kleptomania, but are also easily startled.

name: Scurry
title: Scurry
description: Muridae are quick critters who are used to having to run from Felidae. When not wearing Heavy Armor, they gain +1 Move, and a bonus to their flee chance equal to Scaled SAN/2.

name: Ratsense
title: Ratsense
description: Muridae hear things better in some situations than others. When trying to pick a lock, they gain +10% to the success rate. However, they are naturally oblivious of traps, giving them a -5% chance to detect them.

name: The Mark
title: The Mark
description: A facial mark that all Umbrals have. Whatever appearance it has, it seems to protect the Umbral from the powers of darkness, while making them weaker to holy light. They gain 25% Dark resistance, but 25% Light weakness (both reduced by your Scaled SAN, however; min 0%), and if they take any form of magic damage, they recover 3 FP.

name: Noctis Arcana
title: Noctis Arcana
description: By tapping into the magic that marks them, Umbrals reduce the costs of all Spells they cast during night hours by 25%. However, this effect is reduced by your Scaled SAN (to a minimum of 0%).

name: Mind Scorch
title: Mind Scorch
description: Their psyche assaulted by things far more terrifying than most, the Shaitan is immune to Fear (if below 30 SAN), Hesitation (if below 20 SAN), and Charm (if below 10 SAN).

name: Preordinance
title: Preordinance
description: Capable of seeing into the future in a limited fashion, the Oracle prevents enemies from getting back attacks.

name: Illusion Wing
title: Illusion Wing
description: Entities that thrive around deception like the Papilion are often compatible with elements that support illusions, such as the Wind, granting them 30% Resistance to it. However, the Earth element tells no lies, making Papilion 30% weak to it. Both effects are reduced by your Scaled SAN, to a minimum of 0.

name: Invite Insanity
title: Invite Insanity
description: The Papilion lives in illusion, making others see what isn't actually there. Targets 1 empty tile within 3 Range and creates an attackable Butterfly Illusion. At the start of a new round, it moves towards a nearby enemy. If it's close to them, it will destroy itself. When destroyed, the illusion can inflict either Blind, Fear, Charm, Poison, or Silence (randomly chosen) for 2 rounds on enemies within 1 Range.

name: Theno Physique
title: Theno Physique
description: The unique physique offered by the Theno from spending all their time swimming and singing grants them +15% Water and Sound Resistance, but for the same reasons, gives them a 15% Acid and Lightning Weakness.

name: Voice of the Depths
title: Voice of the Depths
description: The voice of the Theno is powerful, magically so. You gain +25% Status Resistance versus Silence effects. In addition, your base Sound ATK is equal to your character level, but it does not increase from stat points.

name: Lost Sea
title: Lost Sea
description: When you live in the sea, there's not much to fear in the shallows. While your base SAN is 15 or less, you ignore the effects of Dark Water. In addition, Soaked status grants you +15 Evade.

name: Sanguine Crest
title: Sanguine Crest
description: A vampire cannot generate the key Focus required to sustain their own life, but unlike others, they can absorb it from others, most directly from their blood. Upon successfully applying Banquet to an enemy, you gain a permanent status called Sanguine Crest that boosts your STR, WIL, SKI, CEL, and DEF by 2. This effect can unlock other Vampire racial abilities, but when it ends, you gain Crest Burnout LV1 for 3 rounds, reducing those same stats by its LV. (Sanguine Crest will end after the battle, but you will not receive Crest Burnout in that case.)

name: Stillness, Darkness
title: Stillness, Darkness
description: The unique properties of the Vampire condition reduce the effects of Mercana. (Mercala is the goddess of life, and her magic opposes Huggessoa, the creator of vampires, and unlife in general.)

name: Silvermists
title: Silvermists
description: An occult mist that rejuvenates the undead. Consumes 33% of your current Essence and restores HP equal to 3 per Essence, to a minimum of 25. Any excess HP will be converted into FP instead.

name: Lunar Lunatism
title: Lunar Lunatism
description: The true power of the vampire is said to be linked to the moon, and anyone who has seen a vampire go all out can say for certain it has to come from somewhere. Can only be used while Sanguine Crest is active.

name: Spotless
title: Spotless
description: Having built up no tolerance for the dark magic in the outside world, Elves suffer 25% more Dark damage. However, they have a natural resistance against Water damage, reducing damage they take from it by 25%.

name: Spotted
title: Spotted
description: Wild Elves typically have slightly darker blotches of skin which resemble spots. The attunement with nature they provide increases Earth Resistance by 15%, but lowers Ice Resistance by 15%.

name: Superiority
title: Superiority
description: The air of superiority that follows a Zeran is magical and powerful. Any enemy within 1 tile is affected by it, depending on if the Zeran is facing them or not.

name: Reaper Physique
title: Reaper Physique
description: Being used to the cold air inside of Lazarus, the Reaper race is more resistant to Ice damage, gaining 15% resistance to it. However, the still air inside of it has made them weaker to the power of Wind, gaining a 15% weakness to it.

name: Reaper's Affinity
title: Reaper's Affinity
description: Reapers are naturally adept at using polearms, something a great many scholars have tried to understand over the years. The most common theory is simply that they grow used to having one in their hands, as many use them as walking sticks, but the truth is likely more complex and magical.

name: Soul Guide
title: Soul Guide
description: Reapers are agents of Lazarus with a duty to help guide the souls of the lost to it. As such, they are particularly skilled at dealing with those of the Possessed race, dealing +10% damage to them. They are also excellent exorcists, gaining a variety of bonuses; it costs them 50% less stamina to exorcise spirits, and upon successfully doing so, they gain a status effect that increases post-battle HP/FP regen by 10% for 10 rounds, with the duration stacking up to 100 rounds.

name: Macabre Culture
title: Macabre Culture
description: Reapers often wear bones over their clothes as decorations, and the rattling of them is something that serves as an easy indicator of their presence. When wearing equipment of Remains-type material (IE, Dragon Remains), the Reaper gains 2 Elemental ATK from that material, based on what left the remains behind.

name: Magia Detremus
title: Magia Detremus
description: As they are beings mostly comprised of arcane energy, the vessel of the Lich has an almost limitless supply of Focus to draw upon, although it is limited still by time. Increases your maximum FP by 50% (after all modifications), but your maximum HP is reduced by 30% (after all modifications), due to the fragility of the vessel. Both the FP bonus and the HP penalty are increased/reduced respectively by 1% per 2 Scaled SAN.

name: Venom Drive
title: Venom Drive
description: Much like their ancestors, Wyverntouched are empowered by poison that flows in their body. When a Wyverntouched is under the effect of a Poison status, they gain +X STR (where X is equal to half the Poison's level) and recover 5 FP every round. Often, Wyverns would bite themselves, injecting their own venom into their blood to increase their power. In addition, Wyverntouched gain Poison Resistance equal to (Scaled SAN*2)%.

name: Poison Bite
title: Poison Bite
description: The fangs of a Wyvern are poisonous - and, to a lesser degree, so are the fangs of a Wyverntouched. Upon using this skill, you bite into the target, dealing Pierce damage equal to your STR, having a chance to inflict Poison with a LV equal to 10 + half of your Scaled SAN, which lasts 3 rounds.

name: Snakescale
title: Snakescale
description: Needless to say, the naga is half snake. This gives them several benefits common to the serpent races. Increases Slash resistance by 1% per 5 Scaled SAN, and increases Poison resistance by your Scaled SAN.

name: Mechanical Strength
title: Mechanical Strength
description: Unlike many mortal races, the Mechanation is not used to strain and exhaustion in the same way. They gain +20 to their maximum encumbrance. They also gain +1 maximum Physical and Mental Stamina every 2 character levels.

name: Red Dice
title: Red Dice
description: Changes the magical energies surrounding the Redtail into a red color. While red, you gain Hit and Critical equal to 1x (+1x 10 Scaled SAN, max. 5x) per your Fortune Level. However, if your Fortune Level is one, you instead suffer -5 (plus -5 per 10 Scaled SAN) Hit and Critical.

name: Song of Nature
title: Song of Nature
description: A galdr possessed by the Doriad race that causes nature to resonate. Targets 1 Tile in 3 Range. Depending on if the tile selected has a flower in it or not, the effect differs:

name: Wild Grass
title: Wild Grass
description: Targets an enemy within 4 Range and causes grass to wildly erupt around their feet. If successful, the target is Immobilized for 1 round (or 2 rounds if their CEL is higher than yours; +1 round per 16 Scaled SAN).

name: Omina's Curse
title: Omina's Curse
description: Targets an enemy within 4 Range and give them your displeasure, applying Fortune Vacuum to them 3 times.

name: Red Misfortune
title: Red Misfortune
description: Consumes 15 Unluck. Targets 1 tile within 4 Range. The ground beneath it will thin out, creating an invisible Pitfall tile at that location. (The unit that triggers it will lose the rest of their turn.)

name: Immortal Shell
title: Immortal Shell
description: The 'body' of the Dullahan does not possess any of the usual vulnerabilities of flesh, but that is not always a benefit. For example, the ability to heal it with natural medicine, or being able to move as quickly. This skill grants the following bonuses and penalties passively:

name: Soul Engine
title: Soul Engine
description: Rather than utilizing the energy of life, the Dullahan moves by the force of its soul, and in battle, this strains it to the point of exhaustion. It is very easy for a Dullahan to over-exert themself by not realizing how much power they are using, and so the skilled among these cursed souls often fight at a slow pace; something that inspires fear in their enemies.

name: Salamandra Flame
title: Salamandra Flame
description: Conjure flames from will at an enemy within 3 Range, dealing Fire magic damage equal to 100% of Scaled Weapon ATK + 100% of Fire ATK. Afterwards, gain 1 stack of Nairyf Energy (max. 3), which increases the Range of this skill by LV and allows it to ignore certain types of protection.

name: Thundering Blows
title: Thundering Blows
description: While the Oni has Sanguine Crest active, their onslaught becomes deadly, and when attacking an enemy with a melee weapon, gain the following bonuses:

name: Threaded Needle
title: Threaded Needle
description: A level of mechanical precision afforded to the Karakuri through its string-guided movements. They passively gain +3% Parry Activation Rate, +3% Critical, and -1 Farshot Penalty. Additionally, this method of internal control makes them slightly more resilient to being Slowed, Frozen, or Immobilized, gaining +5% Status Resist versus those effects.

name: Karakuri Body
title: Karakuri Body
description: Karakuri possess an artificial body, which has the following effects:

name: Wrap
title: Wrap
description: Performs a basic attack on an adjacent enemy. If it hits, it deals Blunt damage instead of the normal damage type, and automatically applies Grapple to them.

name: Yellow Dice
title: Yellow Dice
description: Changes the magical energies surrounding the Redtail into a yellow color. While yellow, you gain Evade and Critical Evade equal to 1x (+1x 10 Scaled SAN, max. 5x) your Fortune Level. However, if your Fortune Level is one, you instead suffer -5 (plus -5 per 10 Scaled SAN) Evade and Critical Evade.

name: Yellow Misfortune
title: Yellow Misfortune
description: Consumes 5 Unluck. Targets 1 enemy within 4 Range. That enemy will become clumsy, reducing their Hit by 15 for 3 rounds.

name: Wyvern Assimilation
title: Wyvern Assimilation
description: Infused with the blood of a wyvern. +30% status resistance versus Poison.
